row.body: The airport map marks a flight route open, while the gate list says the passengers were transferred before boarding began.
row.title: Airport route update

sidecar.gloss: Passenger transfer is recorded before boarding.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could transfer passengers during a delay; the list does not identify why the route changed.

row.body: red and blue cord join the box of matches to the hand torch. the red route is cut; the blue route ends in a sealed knot.
row.title: missing count beside the box of matches

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
